transcript.zh: 也没有地铁，但我总是只能借到最差的那辆车，

transcript.en: you know, the most terrible car.
transcript.zh: 你知道，就是最烂的那辆。

transcript.en: Which led to so many problems like my car stopping
transcript.zh: 这导致了很多问题，比如车在

transcript.en: working in the middle of the street,
transcript.zh: 马路中间抛锚，

transcript.en: which was never good.
transcript.zh: 这从来都不是什么好事。

transcript.en: We did used to live a little bit further away from
transcript.zh: 我们以前确实住得离市中心

transcript.en: downtown, but we had a good bus system.
transcript.zh: 有点远，但我们有很好的公交系统。

transcript.en: So it would just be like, take the bus,
transcript.zh: 所以他们就会说，坐公交，

transcript.en: it's cheaper and stuff
transcript.zh: 便宜又方便之类的。

transcript.en: like that. So I didn't really get the car that often
transcript.zh: 所以我其实不常拿到车，

transcript.en: until I bought my own or until
transcript.zh: 直到我买了自己的车，或者

transcript.en: I had a motorcycle of my own and then problem solved.
transcript.zh: 有了自己的摩托车，问题就解决了。

transcript.en: All right. Well, I want to know from our listeners,
transcript.zh: 好的。嗯，我想听听听众们的经历，

transcript.en: what did they ask for from their parents? Exactly.
transcript.zh: 他们向父母要过什么？没错。

transcript.en: Did you ask for the
transcript.zh: 你是问父母借

transcript.en: car? Did you ask for money?
transcript.zh: 车？还是问他们要钱？

transcript.en: Or did you ask for a pony? Did you ask for a pony?
transcript.zh: 还是问他们要一匹小马？你要过小马吗？

transcript.en: I had a friend who had a summer home. Really?
transcript.zh: 我有个朋友家里有度假别墅。真的吗？

transcript.en: So he would ask for the keys to the summer home.
transcript.zh: 所以他就会问父母要度假别墅的钥匙。

transcript.en: Okay. Well, come to our website, EnglishPod.com.
transcript.zh: 好的。那来我们的网站吧，EnglishPod.com。

transcript.en: Exactly. Leave your questions and comments.
transcript.zh: 没错。留下你的问题和评论。

transcript.en: We want to hear from you.
transcript.zh: 我们想听到你们的声音。

transcript.en: We want to know what you think.
transcript.zh: 我们想知道你们的想法。

transcript.en: And Erica and I are definitely there to answer any
transcript.zh: Erica和我一定会在那里回答任何

transcript.en: doubts. All right. Well, guys,
transcript.zh: 疑问。好了。各位，

transcript.en: thanks for listening and until next
transcript.zh: 感谢收听，下次

transcript.en: time, bye.
transcript.zh: 再见。
